classifies: canary-result.v1.json (commit 458cc6a) - attempt 1 of the frozen 3-pack strict-schema canary
reclassificationReason: The prior report described this run as an empirical confirmation of CAPABILITY_BLOCKED. That overclaimed: OpenRouter's error metadata names provider_name=ModelRun for all three failures, meaning routing accepted the request's parameters (require_parameters=true did not filter it out) and reached ModelRun's own infrastructure, which returned its own upstream 503 ('no endpoints available', provider_error_code=503, is_byok=false). Had require_parameters=true actually rejected response_format as unsupported, the failure would be a routing/capability error surfaced by OpenRouter itself, before naming a specific provider - not an upstream 503 attributed to ModelRun. This is a transport/capacity outage, not a parameter-support rejection, and not a model or schema failure. Whether ModelRun actually honors strict json_schema remains genuinely UNKNOWN, not FAIL.

counts.transportAttemptsPerCall: up to 3 (1 initial + RemoteInferenceOptions.TransientRequestRetries=2 default), already exhausted internally by OpenRouterHeaderExtractor before the exception surfaced - see IsRetryableStatus(503)=true in OpenRouterHeaderExtractor.cs

doNotRecord: Qwen3.8 = 0/3 (implies a model-quality result; none exists)
RESPONSE_FATAL = model failure (RESPONSE_FATAL is the runtime's representation of 'no response at all', not a judgement on model or schema quality)

whyNoKeyOrRequestChange.apiKey: not the cause - 401/402/429 are the key/quota failure modes; this is upstream 503 from the named provider (ModelRun), which a different OpenRouter key cannot give more GPU/endpoint capacity
whyNoKeyOrRequestChange.requestOrSchema: not changed - the frozen, byte-identical bodies from a9c97ee are the comparison anchor; any edit forfeits comparability with a future successful draw

nextStep.notASemanticRetry: no completion has ever been received for these 3 requests, so there is no model draw yet to regenerate or repair - a transport retry is not a second draw, it is the first attempt to actually reach the model
nextStep.openQuestionRemainingUnknown: does strict json_schema structurally prevent REFERENCES+value on PACK_006? Answer: UNKNOWN, not FAIL.
nextStep.authorizationStatus: the previous authorization (a9c97ee's 3 calls) is consumed by this attempt's 3 transport-failed calls; a fresh explicit authorization is required before any further HTTP request is sent, even a transport-only retry of the same frozen bodies
nextStep.pavedAlternativeNotTaken: the paid qwen/qwen3.8-27b endpoints have materially higher uptime than ModelRun's free tier, but switching to one would be a different experiment/model-route, not a continuation of this free-tier canary, and is not being done

note: This classification file makes no provider call; it only reinterprets canary-result.v1.json's own recorded transport error text.
